document.about: FDA laboratory method (Contains Nonbinding Recommendations). Its first page sets the agency's logo as a picture over the text; an OCR engine reads `FDA U.S. FOOD & DRUG` / `ADMINISTRATION` in it, set larger than any line of the page's own text.

notes: 2026-11-26: the logo's words, read by OCR in its picture, were the document's title. The stored reading is the built-in engine's (PP-OCRv6 small) of the logo's crop: `fdoc dev render-routed --ocr-regions --stored-resolution`, then `fdoc ocr --models`.
2026-11-26 (#455): a title is a `doco:Title` only where it is sure, its evidence naming how (`metadata`, `outline`, `type`); the title's checks look for the type, not the evidence.
